description: This file implements the MediaPipelineModuleService class, which manages media pipeline sessions, client connections, and media source operations via IPC in a media server context. It includes methods for creating/destroying sessions, loading media, attaching/removing sources, playback controls, and retrieving media state information.

classes.name: MediaPipelineModuleService
classes.description: Implements IPC-based management of media pipeline sessions and media sources, handling client connections, session lifecycle, media control commands, and source attachment/removal.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles new client connection, registers the client, and exports the service.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection, cleans up sessions associated with the client, and destroys those sessions.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new media pipeline session, assigns a session ID, and associates it with the client.

methods.name: destroySession
methods.description: Destroys an existing session and removes it from the client's session list.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media into a session based on the provided request parameters.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window position and size for a session.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to a session, constructing the source object based on request parameters.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from a session.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Signals that all media sources are attached for a session.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback for a session.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback for a session.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback for a session.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the playback position for a session.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Informs the media pipeline about available media data.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for a session.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position of a session.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a frame for a session.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume level for a session.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current volume level of a session.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the audio for a session.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Retrieves the mute status of a session.
